item.title: Why is Trump threatening to bomb Oman, the Iran mediator trying to clear Hormuz?
item.description: The world knows that US President Donald Trump is angry with Iran. But he is not happy with the small country lying across the Strait of Hormuz from the Islamic Republic, either: Oman. Oman has played a relatively low profile role since the Iran war began, including as a mediator.
